text: hena nitāi vine bhāi    rādhā-kṛṣṇa pāite nāi
translation: The holy lotus feet of Nitāi, cooling like ten million moons – in the shade of which the world gains soothing relief. Without that Nitāi, O brother, no one can reach Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa – clasp His lotus feet with full conviction.

text: se sambandha nāhi yāra    vṛthā janma gela tāra
nitāi nā balila mukhe    majila saṁsāra-sukhe
translation: One who never got His connection, passed his life in vain – such an animal is so very wicked. He whose mouth never uttered ‘Nitāi,’ merged in mundane pleasures – how can his aristocratic lineage save him?

text: nitāiyer karuṇā habe    vraje rādhā-kṛṣṇa pābe
translation: Maddened with pride, forgetting the lotus feet of Nitāi – I embrace untruth as truth; but when Nitāi gives His grace you’ll reach Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vraja – O embrace the lotus feet of Nitāi!

text: nitāiyer charaṇa satya    tā̐hāra sevaka nitya
narottama baḍa duḥkhī    nitāi more kara sukhī
translation: The lotus feet of Nitāi are truth, His servitors are eternal – ever aspire for the shelter of His feet. Narottam is very sad – O Nitāi make me happy – please keep me at Your lovely lotus feet!
